test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given, followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some engineers are players.

2. All players are atheists.

**Conclusions:**

I. All atheists are players.

II. All engineers are atheists.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bac49a77802549c1f86f274cf6007962ff6b2ecfbd047684a0f261688381867.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All atheists are players → False (As all players are atheists then all atheists are players is possible but not definite)

II. All engineers are atheists → False (As some engineers are players and all players are atheists then all engineers are atheists is not possible)

Hence, the correct answer is **Neither conclusion I nor II follows.**
